name: Lifting the Curse
summary: First Mate Fitzsimmons believes that the restless curse binding his fallen crewmates stems from a dark artifact secured aboard their wrecked ship, the Intrepid. To set his brethren free, an adventurer must face the ghost of Captain Halyndor, take the strongbox key, and recover the relic from the submerged hull.

sections.title: A Captain's Burden
sections.body: First Mate Fitzsimmons survived the tragic fate of the Third Fleet, but the memory of his comrades haunts his waking hours and his dreams. He remains convinced that the undeath gripping his shipmates is tied to a mysterious, malignant object locked away inside the strongbox of his old vessel, the Intrepid. Overseeing the wreck is the spectral remnants of Captain Halyndor, who even in death fiercely guards the key to the vessel's deepest secrets.

sections.title: Unlocking the Depths
sections.body: Off the mist-choked coast of the northern Wetlands lie the fractured hulks of the Third Fleet. Resting within the flooded hull of the Intrepid, the ship's locked strongbox holds the relic at the heart of the crew's misery. Reclaiming it requires defeating Halyndor's tortured ghost on deck, securing the rusted key, and braving the flooded interior to retrieve the dark artifact so that holy hands can cleanse it.

faq.q: What ship are you searching during this quest?
faq.answer: You are searching the Intrepid, the sunken ship of the Third Fleet resting off the northwestern shore of the Wetlands.
Captain Halyndor was the commanding officer of the Intrepid. In death, his restless spirit haunts the deck of the ruined vessel, clinging stubbornly to the key to his ship's strongbox.

faq.q: Why does First Mate Fitzsimmons want the strongbox opened?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons believes a cursed object secured inside the strongbox is responsible for trapping the spirits of his fellow sailors in torment, and opening it is the only way to recover the artifact for purification.

faq.q: Where is the Intrepid's strongbox located?
faq.answer: The strongbox sits submerged inside the lower hull of the Intrepid, accessible through a breach in the side of the wrecked ship beneath the waves.

faq.q: Who can cleanse the cursed object once it is recovered?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons directs adventurers to take the recovered object to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow in Menethil Harbor to have its foul taint cleansed.

faq.q: What caused the shipwreck in the first place?
faq.answer: During the Second War the Third Fleet was attacked by red dragons controlled by orcs, and its ships were burned and sunk off the Wetlands coast; the cursed treasure aboard now keeps the drowned crews from rest.

angles.text: Unraveling spiritual afflictions and cleansing tainted relics requires spiritual authority, which is why Fitzsimmons entrusts the final purification of the strongbox's contents to the priesthood.
The sailors of the Third Fleet served the Alliance in life, and laying their tortured souls to rest is an obligation of honor for Alliance champions traveling through Menethil Harbor.
